name: tools.isup/isup
title: isup.tools — is it down?
description: Website status check: is a site down for everyone or just you? Shows HTTP code, time and location.

tools.name: check_site
tools.description: Check if a website is up or down right now. Use it when someone asks whether a site is down, or if it is just them. Makes one request to the site and returns a verdict sentence, the status (UP, DOWN or NOT CHECKABLE), the HTTP code, the time taken, and the real place the check ran from. The check runs near the machine that calls this tool, which may not be near the end user. The site's content is never read.

url.description: The domain or full URL to check, for example example.com or https://example.com/status. A bare domain is tried over https first.
